title: Duration-aware dependency schedule in an authorized projection
description: Conditional earliest/latest offsets, slack and critical chain from explicit dependent-to-prerequisite edges and qualified nonnegative integer durations. Optional generation-fenced targets select their complete transitive prerequisite closure; omitted or empty targets select all vertices. Every selected prerequisite requires a usable duration. Cycles, unavailable durations, overflow and exhausted budgets refuse the complete result. Units are those of the named source field; worker/resource contention and native completion are not established. No observation, plan, effect or authority is created. Runtime additionally checks UTF-8 byte lengths, u64 IDs, duplicate entity IDs, complete source custody, work, wall and final output budgets.
